cli.hostname_caption: Change only if you are using GitHub Enterprise Server
cli.intro_scopes: The scopes come from the GitHub CLI and cannot be changed from Gitify. Its <0>repo</0> scope covers notification access; run <1>gh auth refresh -s notifications</1> to grant that scope explicitly.
cli.intro_token: Uses the token your local <0>gh</0> install already holds, so no token has to be created or pasted. Gitify reads it from the CLI on every refresh, which means <1>gh auth login</1> and <2>gh auth refresh</2> keep working without re-authenticating here.
cli.login_failed: Failed to login with GitHub CLI against {{hostname}}
cli.title: Login with GitHub CLI

custom_oauth.enable_device_flow: and enable its <0>device flow</0>, then use its client ID below.
custom_oauth.hostname_caption: Change only if you are using GitHub Enterprise Server
custom_oauth.intro: Authorize Gitify with your own GitHub OAuth app. Create an app, enable its device flow, then paste its client ID below.
custom_oauth.title: Login with Custom OAuth App

pat.hostname_caption_enterprise: Change only if you are using GitHub Enterprise Server
pat.hostname_caption_gitea: Your instance hostname or origin, e.g. gitea.example.com or http://git.internal:3000. Defaults to HTTPS.
pat.hostname_caption_gitlab: Your GitLab instance hostname (for example gitlab.com)
pat.invalid_token: Failed to validate provided token against {{hostname}}
pat.scopes_note: Use a classic personal access token; fine-grained tokens are not supported. The <0>recommended scopes</0> will be automatically selected for you.
pat.scopes_note_gitlab: Requires the <0>api</0> scope, or a fine-grained token with <1>Todo</1> (read, update) and <2>User</2> (read) permissions. GitLab shows your To-Do items, so you will see fewer notifications than on GitHub.
pat.title_bitbucket: Login to Bitbucket Cloud with API Token
pat.title_gitea: Login to Gitea with Personal Access Token
pat.title_gitlab: Login to GitLab with Personal Access Token

pat.token_settings_caption_gitea: on your Gitea instance to create a token, then paste it below.
pat.token_settings_caption_github: on GitHub to paste the token below.

reasons.agent_session_finished_description: A GitHub Copilot cloud agent session finished running.
reasons.approval_requested_description: You were requested to review and approve a deployment.
reasons.assign_description: You were assigned to the issue.
reasons.author: Authored
reasons.ci_activity_description: A GitHub Actions workflow run was triggered for your repository.
reasons.invitation_description: You accepted an invitation to contribute to the repository.
reasons.manual_description: You subscribed to the thread (via an issue or pull request).
reasons.member_feature_requested_description: Organization members have requested to enable a feature such as Draft Pull Requests or Copilot.
reasons.mention_description: You were specifically @mentioned in the content.
reasons.review_requested_description: You, or a team you're a member of, were requested to review a pull request.
reasons.security_advisory_credit_description: You were credited for contributing to a security advisory.
reasons.security_alert_description: GitHub discovered a security vulnerability in your repository.
reasons.state_change_description: You changed the thread state (for example, closing an issue or merging a pull request).
reasons.team_mention_description: You were on a team that was mentioned.
reasons.unknown_description: The reason for this notification is not supported by the app.

alerts.play_sound_help: Play a sound when new unread notifications arrive after filtering. Use the notification volume controls to adjust the sound level.
alerts.show_desktop_help: Display native operating system notifications for new unread notifications.
alerts.show_updates_help: Show a notification when a {{appName}} update is ready. Updates are still checked and shown in the menu bar.
alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.volume_help: Adjust the volume of the notification sound.

appearance.design_help: Choose Classic for the original {{appName}} layout, or Glass for the translucent, layered design language.
appearance.increase_contrast_help: Use GitHub's high-contrast color schemes for improved legibility. Also applied automatically when your system's increase-contrast setting is enabled.
appearance.language_help: Choose the language for the {{appName}} interface.
appearance.show_status_icon_colors_help: Color the notification type icons by their state (open, closed, done, attention). Glass renders them monochrome by default.
appearance.theme_help: Choose a light, dark, or system color mode. Available options depend on the selected design language.
appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.zoom_help: Change the size of the {{appName}} interface. The setting applies immediately and is remembered for the next launch.

inbox.delay_state_help: Keep the notification in {{appName}} after interacting with it until the next refresh window.
inbox.fetch_all_help: When checked, fetch all notifications from your inbox.
inbox.fetch_all_help_unchecked: When unchecked, fetch only the first page of notifications.
inbox.fetch_detailed_caution: Users with a large number of unread notifications may experience rate limiting.
inbox.fetch_detailed_help: Enrich notifications with detailed user and state information. You may also choose to display notification metrics.
inbox.fetch_interval_help: Check for new notifications at this interval. Shorter intervals keep the list fresher but spend more API requests.
inbox.fetch_read_done_caution: GitHub's API does not distinguish between read and done states, so Mark as done actions are unavailable while this is enabled.
inbox.fetch_read_help: Fetch all notifications including read and done.
inbox.fetch_read_rate_caution: This increases API usage and may cause rate limiting for users with many notifications.
inbox.github_requires_account: GitHub-specific options require a GitHub account.
inbox.group_by_help: Choose how notifications are displayed in the list.
inbox.mark_done_caption: Requires GitHub Cloud or GitHub Enterprise Server 3.13 or later.
inbox.mark_done_help: Mark as done is supported by GitHub Cloud and GitHub Enterprise Server 3.13 or later.
inbox.participating_help: When checked, fetch only participating notifications.
inbox.participating_help_unchecked: When unchecked, fetch participating and watching notifications.
inbox.scope_warning: One or more accounts are missing scopes required for notification enrichment. Notification details may be incomplete.
inbox.show_account_header_help: Show your avatar, username, and quick links above the notifications list.
inbox.title: Inbox
inbox.wrap_notification_title_help: Wrap long notification titles onto multiple lines instead of truncating them.

notifications.participating_docs_title: Open GitHub documentation for participating and watching notifications

reset.confirm_content: Please confirm that you want to reset all settings to the {{appName}} defaults
reset.title: Reset Settings

system.enable_shortcut_help: Show or hide {{appName}} from anywhere with a keyboard shortcut.
system.gnome_extension_help: On GNOME Wayland, install the Gitify extension to open the window next to its tray icon. Install and manage it through GNOME's extension tools.
system.keep_window_on_blur_help: Keep the {{appName}} window open when you click outside it.
system.login_item_not_found: The login item could not be found. Turn Launch at startup off and on again to re-register it.
system.login_item_not_registered: Launch at startup is on, but the login item is not registered. Turn it off and on again to re-register it.
system.login_item_requires_approval: macOS requires you to approve the login item before {{appName}} can launch at startup. Approve it in System Settings > General > Login Items.
system.login_item_windows_disabled: Windows has disabled the startup entry. Enable {{appName}} in Task Manager > Startup.
system.open_links_background_help: <0>Background</0> opens the link without stealing focus from the current window.
system.open_links_foreground_help: <0>Foreground</0> brings the opened window or browser to the front.
system.open_links_help: Controls whether opening an external link brings the destination app to the front.
system.open_links_help_scope: This applies to every link {{appName}} opens, including notification links opened in the browser.
system.title: System
system.use_x11_backend_help: Run {{appName}} under X11/XWayland so the window can open next to the tray icon. Takes effect after restarting {{appName}}.

tray.highlight_unread_help: Turn the {{appName}} logo green while there are unread notifications.
tray.idle_icon_help: Pick a light icon for dark panels or a dark icon for light panels.
tray.idle_icon_help_automatic: Automatic follows the tray appearance on macOS and Windows; Linux uses light because panel detection is unreliable.
tray.idle_icon_help_theme: This setting is independent of the {{appName}} app theme.
tray.show_notification_count_help: Show the unread notification count next to the tray icon. Useful for a quick glance at unread activity.
tray.title: Tray
